# Cedar document browsers

Open [Requirements](requirements.html) to read the needs, stages and related documents. [Execution](execution.html) opens the supplied source call path independently. The other owner pages are [Specification](specification.html), [Program Design](program-design.html) and [Verification](verification.html).

The [original request](input/request.md) and [supplied facts](input/facts.json) show the input data structure. The five HTML files own the actual inline record metadata and rich bodies; `facts.json` is authoring input, not a runtime data API. All importer facts, procedures and results are invented examples, not product measurements.

## Provenance and limits

A fresh Luna/high author received a neutral request, supplied facts and the candidate component guide/binding. The first five pages passed the static checker but omitted the supplied design Markdown. **One externally guided correction** restored that exact Markdown, including its code, emphasis and external link, while leaving the design gap separate. This is not a first-pass or guide-only success result.

The accepted corrected artifact's recorded independent checks found 0 issues in 115 source checks, 0 failures in 46 reader checks, and 18 matching call details. The existing browser capture passed its two selected 1600/390 CSS-pixel cases; 25 other cases were name-filtered skips. These are the recorded named-case observations, not scores rerun by this source integration. [Provenance and source hashes](provenance.json) retain the qualified result.

The evidence does not establish a complete Cedar guide-loading/action history, general author reliability, model cost or total usage. There is no prior-guide control or improvement claim. An earlier framed trial is excluded from formal guide-behavior evaluation; a separate Harbor lookup is only complementary evidence and does not supply Cedar's missing action history.

## Local binding

These pages preserve the accepted author output, including metadata, bodies, controls, introductory text and states. Only each page's theme and runtime URLs changed to `./demistify/theme.css` and `./demistify/runtime.js`. The existing PoC builder copies this folder and the complete matching library beside it; two loose asset files would be insufficient.

From the repository root, `pnpm build` produces the example at `apps/demistify-poc/dist/experiments/agent-written/cedar-documents/requirements.html`. It uses public components without a private renderer, framework, custom stylesheet or interaction script. Source/CLI/build checks remain distinct from a new app-render or hosted-release observation.
